email.subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – thank-you page, email domain and invoices
email.body_text:
Hi Anita,

Thank you for your time on our call. You came with a list covering your thank-you page, mobile landing page, email domain, invoices and course. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we resolved:
- Your thank-you page redirect is set up, and your test order now goes to your page.
- The overlapping mobile buttons are fixed, and you confirmed they look fine.
- We have extended your EARLYBIRD coupon so it is live again.

What we covered:
- Our AI quiz generator is coming very soon and we will make sure you get early access.
- Upgrade to our premium plan to unlock more templates and faster support.

Your next steps:
1. Have your developer add the three DNS records by Friday, then click Verify in your email settings.

What we'll do next:
- We will check with our billing team about changing the name on your invoices and get back to you within 2 working days.
- We will check with our product team whether the drip schedule works for a course sold inside a bundle and get back to you.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-10

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
